thread:
monitor-bot: [ALERT] spike in 5xx on /v1/embeddings (eu-west-1). error-rate 22% over baseline. origin=routing-service.
oncall_tony: ack — paging SRE. @sre_jamie can you take a look? Looks like a fallback pattern.
sre_jamie: on it, pulling routing + model logs now.
sre_jamie: quick grep — incoming requests for alias `embeddings-prod` are being routed to variant `chat-raven-1.0` (chat) instead of embed-optimized variants. many requests failing schema validation -> 500s.
eng_kim: that screams pin/version mismatch. which alias got pinned?
sre_jamie: config dump from routing-config in prod (short):
```
alias: embeddings-prod
pinned_version: model:v2.3-chat-raven-1.0
fallback_policy: allow-variant-fallback
```
eng_kim: ugh. Did a pin rollout run recently?
prod_lead_ravi: customer impact — are they seeing incorrect outputs or hard failures?
support_maria: several customers reported failures in embeddings ingest. stack shows schema validator error: expected float vector got chat tokens. ~4 customers, spike triggered support tickets.
oncall_tony: ok escalate to platform eng. @eng_kim can you push a hotfix to stop the bad routing?
eng_kim: propose immediate mitigation: 1) disable fallback for embeddings alias 2) force allowed_variants to embed-optimized variants 3) roll back the automated pin.
eng_kim: applying manual patch to routing policy now:
```
PATCH /routing/aliases/embeddings-prod
{
  "pinned_version": null,
  "allowed_variants": ["embed-optimized-v1","instruct-embed-v2"]
}
```
deploy-bot: starting config apply in eu-west-1 (deploy id: dpl-9012)
deploy-bot: config apply succeeded (hash: abc123)
sre_jamie: watching metrics... 5xx rate dropping.
monitor-bot: error-rate -> 3.2% after ~45s from change.
support_maria: customers reporting recovery. I'll note affected customers and open outreach.
eng_kim: quick root cause: automated pinning job used a permissive alias match. pin-job matched `embeddings-prod` to latest model artifact with substring `chat` because of a new naming rule change — ended up pinning a chat variant. fallback_policy allowed serving compatible variants, but chat <-> embed are incompatible so schema validation failed.
eng_kim: mitigation done. next steps: revert the pin rollout (already done), tighten alias->variant matching in pin-job, and add unit/regression tests that assert alias type. I'll open PRs now.
prod_lead_ravi: summary for customers: 4 impacted, brief SLA blip (~8–10m), no data loss, ingest retries succeeded. recommend offering credit? @support_maria please coordinate.
support_maria: will draft comms and targeted outreach. logging correlation ids saved.
sre_jamie: saved full request/response snapshots and routing traces to /mnt/incident/3011223344 for postmortem.
oncall_tony: handing off to morning SRE/Platform rotation for postmortem and follow-ups. We'll publish a timeline + RCA doc. :white_check_mark: 
monitor-bot: incident resolved. TL;DR — wrong variant pinned to embeddings alias + permissive fallback -> requests routed to chat variant -> schema validation 500s. Manual policy override restored correct routing.
eng_kim: follow-up PRs: disable permissive fallback by default for alias types, add strict model type checks in the pin job, add post-deploy validation.
prod_lead_ravi: good catch by alerts & quick handoff. keep this thread for notes.
support_maria: logging outreach plan in #customer-commits.
monitor-bot: incident closed (duration ~9m). All artifacts saved under incident/3011223344.
